constraints.statement: Rust participation and explanation are part of the intended outcome.

counterfactual.conclusion: Rust is justified because it is an explicit outcome, but the delivery method must preserve learning rather than merely output code.

residualRisks: The learning value depends on active participation

costsAndPain: Tutorial work is disconnected from a real deliverable
currentBaseline.description: The transformation is currently performed manually and the user has only tutorial-level Rust experience.

desiredOutcomes.statement: The user can perform the target file transformation reliably from the command line.

successMeasures: The user can explain the main ownership and error-handling choices

disposition.rationale: The language choice is legitimate because learning Rust is itself an accepted outcome.

criteria: Disposition follows the stated authority and evidence
